verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents broad programmatic access across its own surfaces: REST APIs and client libraries for automation, the gcloud CLI for API interactions, programmatic billing management, Terraform-based infrastructure, and machine-readable Discovery documents per API. No evidence states that everything doable in the console is also exposed via the API, so UI parity is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit API/console parity commitment, evidence that console-only features are absent, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Google Cloud APIs allow you to automate your workflows by using your favorite language.
The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
Use the Google API Discovery Service to build client libraries, IDE plugins, and other tools that interact with Google APIs
